targets.expr:
(
  max by(name) (nezha_mem_used{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"})
  /
  max by(name) (nezha_mem_total{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"})
)

(
max by(name) (nezha_disk_used{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"})
/
max by(name) (nezha_disk_total{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"})
)

(
  max by(name) (nezha_swap_used{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"})
  /
  max by(name) (nezha_swap_total{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"})
)

(
  max by(name) (avg_over_time(nezha_mem_used{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"}[$avg_over_time]))
  /
  max by(name) (avg_over_time(nezha_mem_total{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"}[$avg_over_time]))
)

(
  max by(name) (avg_over_time(nezha_swap_used{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"}[$avg_over_time]))
  /
  max by(name) (avg_over_time(nezha_swap_total{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"}[$avg_over_time]))
)

(
  max by(name) (avg_over_time(nezha_net_in_speed{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"}[$avg_over_time]))
  +
  max by(name) (avg_over_time(nezha_net_out_speed{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"}[$avg_over_time]))
)

(
max by(name) (avg_over_time(nezha_disk_used{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"}[$avg_over_time]))
/
max by(name) (avg_over_time(nezha_disk_total{job="$job", group=~"$group", name=~"$name"}[$avg_over_time]))
)
